title: How CRED is tapping AI to deliver premium customer experiences
summary: CRED is improving premium customer experiences in India with OpenAI, using GPT-powered tools to boost support accuracy, cut response times, and raise customer satisfaction.
body: CRED is improving premium customer experiences in India with OpenAI, using GPT-powered tools to boost support accuracy, cut response times, and raise customer satisfaction.
summaryZh: 印度金融科技公司CRED通过集成OpenAI的GPT技术，显著优化了其客户服务体验。通过部署GPT驱动的工具，CRED实现了支持准确率的提升、响应时间的缩短以及客户满意度的显著增长。该案例展示了大型语言模型在处理复杂金融客户咨询、自动化支持流程方面的实际应用价值，为金融行业AI转型提供了参考。

aiReview.reasonZh: 展示了GPT模型在金融科技领域提升客户服务效率的实际落地案例。
